hwd.author: Vittorio Pippi and Fabio Quattrini and Silvia Cascianelli and Rita Cucchiara
hwd.title: {HWD}: A Novel Evaluation Score for Styled Handwritten Text Generation
hwd.evidence: ORIGIN OF HWD, established from the BMVC 2023 official proceedings page (proceedings.bmvc2023.org/7/): the paper states in its abstract 'we devise the Handwriting Distance (HWD), tailored for HTG evaluation', and the page's own citation block gives these four authors, this title and BMVA 2023. Independent confirmation: arXiv API id_list=2310.20316 (title and all four authors matched, comment 'Accepted at BMVC2023'); the authors' code repository github.com/aimagelab/HWD describes HWD as 'the primary evaluation score introduced in the paper'; and the HTG-evaluation survey arXiv:2409.02683 cites this paper as the 'newly introduced' Handwriting Distance. The VGG16 backbone is pretrained on the Font2 synthetic text-image set. No Crossref DOI is registered for BMVC 2023 papers, so none is recorded. DiffBrush cites this work as reference 45 and calls HWD 'newly proposed'.
